subject.title: feat(gateway): make the default node.invoke timeout configurable

question: Should OpenClaw add a global `gateway.nodes.invokeTimeoutMs` fallback, or should it first limit the fix to correctly propagating each resolved `exec host=node` deadline?
rationale: The proposed key creates a new public configuration contract, while the reported production failure is specifically caused by a missing per-call message-level deadline; code review cannot safely choose which long-running-node policy should be permanent.

options.title: Prioritize per-call propagation
options.body: Repair the existing `exec host=node` path so its resolved deadline reaches both the gateway registry and node command, then reconsider whether a global fallback is still needed.

options.title: Sponsor the global fallback too
options.body: Keep the new setting only with canonical config-schema integration, explicit semantics for zero and oversized values, and live upgrade and connected-node proof.

recommendation.title: Prioritize per-call propagation
recommendation.body: Repair the existing `exec host=node` path so its resolved deadline reaches both the gateway registry and node command, then reconsider whether a global fallback is still needed.

likelyOwner.reason: Their adjacent timeout-semantics report defines the current normalization invariant that this product decision must preserve.
